rules: No generic sans fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. IBM Plex Sans brings the necessary engineering/technical authority.
ALL data values, telemetry metrics, and tabular data MUST use JetBrains Mono (or IBM Plex Mono) for tabular, anti-jitter alignment.
Headings should be uppercase with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for a tactical dashboard feel.
Overlines and labels must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Do not exceed text-4xl for the largest headings. This is an engineering workstation, not a marketing page.
Near-black backgrounds (#050505) with dark graphite panels (#0F0F0F).
Use 1px technical borders everywhere to separate panels. NO SHADOWS.
Restrained use of color: Red is for alerts/actions, Amber for warnings, Green ONLY for positive/normal states.
No gradients. Color is for function and data visualization, not decoration.
Use grid-cols-12 or grid-cols-24 for the main dashboard area to allow dense, technical panel arrangements.
Tight spacing: gap-2 or gap-4. Minimal padding inside panels (p-3 or p-4).
Persistent Left Sidebar (w-64) containing navigation (Command Center, Data Hub, Trace Lab, Strategy, Validation, AI Race Engineer).
Sharp edges: Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm. No excessive rounded cards.
Use border-collapse techniques to create a 'Technical Grid' look with exposed skeletons.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #222222 on all panels. Active panels get a #383838 or subtle accent colored top-border (2px).
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces only. NO GLASSMORPHISM. This is an engineering tool, glass implies refraction which reduces clarity.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle graph-paper or engineering gridlines (bg-[size:20px_20px] bg-[linear-gradient(to_right,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px),linear-gradient(to_bottom,#80808012_1px,transparent_1px)]) in empty spaces.

data_provenance.description: Strict labeling for all metrics and data points. Never invent arbitrary data.

labels.MEASURED: Subtle gray outline badge, white text.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none), 1px borders, hover effects that invert background/text or add a subtle left border highlight. Primary actions use accent_red.
components.charts: Use Recharts. Thicker, vibrant lines for the 'TRACE SIGNAL'. Thin, low-opacity, gray lines for 'RAW NOISE'. Always include monospace axes and technical tooltips with a dark graphite background and 1px border. No smooth curves, use monotone or step for telemetry accuracy.
components.tables: Dense rows (h-8 or h-10). Tabular numbers. Explicit Lap Classification table (clean, contaminated, out, in, pit, yellow, etc.) using subtle row background tints for excluded/abnormal laps.
components.sidebar: Darker than the main background (#030303), thin right border. Navigation items should look like terminal tabs or technical directories.
components.data_hub: File upload dropzone with deterministic CSV/JSON parse state. Clear indicators for 'detected field availability', 'coverage', and 'data quality'.

rules: No bouncy spring animations. Motion should feel like a high-performance military/motorsport HUD.
Fade-in data streams. Immediate hover feedback for data inspection.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React (using .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI primitives (customized for sharp borders and dark mode), Recharts, Lucide React / Phosphor Icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_integrity: DO NOT FABRICATE telemetry, grip, fuel, temperatures, or SHAP scores. Use deterministic demo data payloads only. Build the flow to parse a mock uploaded CSV/JSON.
instructions_to_main_agent.core_flow: Implement the EXACT layout: 1. Command Center, 2. Data Hub, 3. Trace Lab, 4. Strategy, 5. Validation, 6. AI Race Engineer.
instructions_to_main_agent.chart_modes: In Command Center, the Degradation Signal chart MUST have toggleable modes: RAW, CORRECTED, PREDICTED, ALL.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-telemetry-btn', data-testid='strategy-simulate-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_1: You tend to converge toward generic SaaS aesthetics. Force the 'F1 Race Engineer Workstation' look: dense, sharp, dark, heavily bordered, monospace-heavy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_2: NEVER use a global transition:all. Apply specific, fast transitions to avoid breaking transforms.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_3: Do NOT center-align the app. Technical dashboards must be left-aligned and structured to grid-cols.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_4: Do NOT use emoji icons (🤖, etc). Use high-quality Phosphor or Lucide icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_5: Avoid empty states that look like generic consumer apps. If data is missing, display 'AWAITING TELEMETRY' in monospace with a loading cursor block.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.rule_6: Always explicitly set text color on hover/focus states to ensure contrast over dark graphite panels.
